summary: This bill requires the Secretary of State to develop a strategy for the U.S. government to secure international support for developing and commercializing products that combat pandemics and epidemics, including antimicrobial-resistant pathogens.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses on international collaboration for developing and commercializing products to combat pandemics and epidemics, including antimicrobial-resistant pathogens. This directly relates to public health and healthcare infrastructure globally, aiming to prevent outbreaks and strengthen health capabilities, which aligns with a more public health-oriented approach.
